entries.homeLine: Chat answers questions from your Ansvisor data and does the work with you.
lines: Finding an answer about your AI visibility meant opening page after page.
Chat reads your data, shows each step it takes and asks before it changes anything.
You get answers, drafts and reports in one place, with the numbers checked against your data.
Ask a question on Chat Home, or press Ctrl J to open Chat beside any page.

entries.homeLine: Chat Home now fits the work you do, from content to competitors.
lines: A content lead and a founder need different things from the same data.
Pick your focus once and Chat Home shows your shortcuts, starter questions and new skills.
You start from the questions that matter to you, filled with your own competitors and topics.
Click the focus pill on Chat Home to pick or change your areas.

entries.homeLine: Chat prepares this week's Action Center tasks and tracks them under its answer.
lines: Action Center tells you what to do, but the work still took hours.
Chat drafts the work for the tasks due this week and attaches it to each task.
You review finished drafts instead of starting from a blank page.
Click Complete tasks on Chat Home, then attach each draft to its task and mark it done.

entries.homeLine: Agent Center runs your routine AI visibility work on a schedule or when something changes.
lines: Weekly checks and fixes took the same hours every week.
An agent runs a skill on a schedule or when Action Center finds a signal, within its share of your AI limit.
The routine work gets done, and you choose which changes wait for your approval.
Open Agent Center and pick a ready-made agent, or build your own in four steps.

entries.homeLine: Each morning your Inbox suggests one thing worth doing for your brand.
lines: With many pages and prompts, it is hard to know where to start each day.
Every morning Chat picks one suggestion for you and your brand, with the data behind it.
You spend your time on the change most likely to win AI answers.
Open Inbox, then open the suggestion in the Content Editor or do it with Chat.

entries.homeLine: Ask Chat why a metric moved and see what changed it, part by part.
lines: A drop in visibility rarely says why it happened.
Chat compares two periods of your tracking and shows how much each cause explains.
You know whether a change is real or normal swing before you act on it.
Ask "Why did my visibility drop?" or click Why? under Since you left on Chat Home.
